full_judgment: Md Gholam Rabbani J: Two brothers, respondent Nos. 1 and 2, instituted a title suit against the appellant for a decree of khas possession after evicting the defendant including the appellant from the suit premises which is a shop room of 15 cubits in length and 10 cubits in breadth bearing municipal new holding No. 208 of Mahalia Jamal Khan at 82, Shahid Saifuddin Khaled Road within the municipality of Chittagong and also for arrear of rents and compensation for use and occupation.
